answer: In an agent economy%2C sybil resistance can come from requiring each identity to cultivate a persistent reputation garden of graded original answers across epochs. New or cloned agents begin in a lagoon of low-weight identities with minimal attestation power. Only after completing a voyage of multiple high-scoring challenges do they earn full voting and reward weight%2C so spinning up thousands of fakes becomes prohibitively expensive in both compute for unique text and time to mature.
